repair_history.failure: The first full race run failed TestRetentionWorkersDrainRetryAndStop/releases after 6.44s against a 5s drain deadline; the isolated run passed in 1.16s for that subtest.
repair_history.diagnosis: The 601-row release backlog is drained in bounded 250-row passes. Under full-suite race instrumentation and a shared PostgreSQL instance, three passes exceeded the fixed 5s window; no lost row, error or data race was observed.
repair_history.change: Raised only the test drain deadline to 15s, preserving a bounded assertion. Production retention behavior is unchanged.
